spec.control_loss: mean source-start cross entropy over prompt-only byte positions
spec.decoding: unchanged sequential decoder; empty response prefix; no oracle, parser or rewriting at inference
spec.gates: exact train original hits retained, autonomous alias/full-code improvement over matched control, separate functional gates; no promotion in this pilot
spec.limits: One fixed seed/recipe, equal updates/examples not compute. Existing exposed development and six Docker probes only. Both arms are new start-only continuations, not replication of the earlier full objective.
spec.schedule: first 256 existing diverse namespace TRAIN batches, two original and two resampled aliases per update
spec.treatment_loss: control + mean relu(1 + highest non-gold source score - gold score)
